# migration

Strangler-fig cutovers and breaking-change policy - every removal classified, dated and measured before consumers move.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-BREAK-001` | critical | Removing an operation is always breaking |
| `AF-BREAK-002` | high | Type and format changes are breaking |
| `AF-BREAK-003` | high | Tightening requirements is breaking |
| `AF-BREAK-004` | medium | Response additions are safe; response removals are not |
| `AF-BREAK-005` | medium | Deprecation is dated, announced and measurable |
| `AF-BREAK-006` | medium | Semantic-version the contract, not the implementation |
| `AF-BREAK-007` | medium | Enum and constant additions are breaking for closed clients |
